WITH d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8
),
sr AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
),
ss AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS day_diff
    FROM ss
    JOIN sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
           AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
           AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.day_diff <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.day_diff > 30 AND j.day_diff <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.day_diff > 60 AND j.day_diff <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.day_diff > 90 AND j.day_diff <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.day_diff > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM joined j
JOIN store s ON j.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
